integrity: The general arguments use explicit binomial probabilities, triangular multinomial characteristic functions, and a Fourier local limit proof. Standard asymptotic tools are identified. Finite computations support but cannot prove infinite claims. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
limitations: The theorem applies to independent fair unary labels on full depth-two n-ary trees and fixed-offset rare category count comparisons. Variable child degrees, non-fair colours, or growing offsets are not covered. General Boolean-fragment parity limits are shown without a universal quantitative rate; the sharp quarter-power expansion is for two-category comparisons and a specified gated formula.
title: Parity-limit spectrum and quarter-power boundary for balanced counting-modal formulas
